name: CO2 mineralisation (in-situ basalt)
principle: CO2 is dissolved in water at the surface and injected into basalt, where it reacts with calcium, magnesium and iron in the rock to form carbonate minerals. At Hellisheidi in Iceland, Carbfix reports nearly 95% of injected CO2 mineralised within two years. The Coda Terminal is planned to mineralise 3 Mt CO2 when fully operating in 2031. IEA rates CO2 mineralisation (inert carbonate materials) at TRL 9.
